description_en: Invoke the QueryFailReasonForRegistrantProfileRealNameVerification API to query the reasons why identity verification for an information template failed the Review
description_zh: 调用QueryFailReasonForRegistrantProfileRealNameVerification接口查询信息模板实名认证审核失败的原因
name: QueryFailReasonForRegistrantProfileRealNameVerification

parameters.help_en: The User IP address. You can set it to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the information template for which identity verification failed. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html API to query the template ID
parameters.help_zh: 实名认证失败的信息模板编号。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id

Data.description_en: The List of reasons why identity verification failed the Review
Data.description_zh: 实名认证审核失败原因列表

FailReason.description_en:
The reason why identity verification failed the Review.

For Solutions after identity verification fails the Review, see [Reasons for identity verification failure and Solutions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35885.html）
FailReason.description_zh:
实名认证审核失败的原因。

实名认证审核失败后的处理方法，请参见[实名认证失败原因及解决方案]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35885.html）
FailReason.example: 证件电子信息核验不合格
